The retired sentence itself (「silently overwrite each other」) is still in the file exactly once — the record is annotated, its text untouched.
- **(b) Every claim the note makes is in ADR-0048 where the note says — read by this seat, not the report.** §1.2 (「The silence is in the *read*, not the write」) shows `storageKey = packageId ? \`${packageId}:${baseName}\` : baseName` and says two packages 「do **not** overwrite one map entry」; its root-cause line is 「context-free resolution + a missing package coordinate in the address — not a write conflict」. §3.3 is headed 「Resolution is package-scoped (prefer-local, qualify-to-cross)」. §3.4 reads 「The cross-package **throw is retired**」. The note's last clause — the lint stands on authoring hygiene and the flat link namespace — is the reading already landed on `origin/main` in `packages/cli/src/utils/collect-docs.ts` (#19359): `docs/duplicate-name` rests on authoring hygiene (the class ADR-0048 §3.4 keeps), `docs/namespace-prefix` / `docs/namespace-required` rest on the flat link namespace. The date 2026-06-13 is ADR-0048's own `**Status**: Revised (2026-06-13)`.
- **(c) House form — right, with precedent in the tree.** An inline supersession clause on a status line: ADR-0012 :3 「… · **Superseded by [ADR-0030](…)** (2026-06-01) — …」; the 「in part」 wording: ADR-0053 :3 「**Partly superseded (2026-07-29, …):**」. A blockquote amendment inside the section it amends: ADR-0046's own §6.7 (`> **Amendment (framework#3963).**`). The clause opens with `·`, the separator ADR-0012 uses, so it reads the same whether the renderer keeps the soft break or folds it.
- **(d) Placement — argued and right.** The claim sits in bullet 1 of a six-bullet list; a block between bullets would split the list, so the note closes the section. Every section reference in the note is spelled 「its §N」, so nothing reads against ADR-0046's own `### 3.3` two lines below.
